description: TransBigData provides Python tools for cleaning, aggregating and analysing transport trajectories. Its contributors publish workflows for taxi GPS records, bicycle-sharing observations and bus GPS data. Documented functions include taxi origin-destination extraction, bus arrival and departure identification, geographic gridding, polygon aggregation and trajectory reconstruction. Users choose the study area and input observation period; grid size and temporal coverage depend on the selected records, not a fixed package dataset. GitHub hosts English and Chinese documentation, and the package is distributed through PyPI and conda-forge. The repository metadata states BSD-3-Clause, permitting free software reuse. Its outputs can help prepare demand and movement inputs or check simulated activity against observations. Limitations include dependence on source sampling and data quality; the package is not itself a traffic-flow simulator, and access rights to input trajectories must be checked separately. Related records model-sumo and model-matsim represent simulators for which such processed movement information may be useful. No direct file-conversion interface to either was verified, and no trajectory data were downloaded.
